actions.heading: What to do first, and why
paragraphs: Begin with the archive-class move, because it carries the largest saving at {O1.monthly_saving_usd} USD a month; verify read frequency and retrieval fees before any transfer. Next verify duplicate objects by content before deleting, since the {O2.reclaimable_gib} GiB is a size-based estimate.

Defer database cold storage and the smaller database strategies, whose returns are small. Keep all {F018} as specifications only until rights are bound to each candidate and personal data is removed or aggregated. Finally, grant read access to artists_app so a re-census can firm up the figures.

compare.heading: Three priced strategies compared
paragraphs: The archive-class move addresses {O1.reclaimable_gib} GiB for {O1.monthly_saving_usd} USD a month. Duplicate-object reconciliation addresses {O2.reclaimable_gib} GiB for {O2.monthly_saving_usd} USD. Database cold storage addresses {O3.reclaimable_gib} GiB for {O3.monthly_saving_usd} USD.

All three are priced at reference list prices, not the owner's invoice, and archive-class retrieval carries its own fee. The comparison shows scale and conditions; it does not by itself settle the choice.

These are estimates from complete passes where tables allowed and stratified samples elsewhere. They indicate that cleansing, not de-duplication, is the main work before any product can be built.

exhibit_S003.heading: Reclaimable bytes sit almost entirely in object stores
paragraphs: Moving buckets not written for over a year and reconciling duplicate objects address most of the reclaimable bytes. Together with database cold storage, the three largest strategies address {K004} of the {F021} GiB reached by all strategies.

Reclaimable bytes are not realised savings. Last write is the newest object timestamp in a listing, read frequency was not measured, and duplicate candidates share a size and an identifying label, which for multipart uploads is not a content hash.

risks.heading: What cannot yet be said
paragraphs: Sampled ratios, unmeasured rights and licences, the unreadable artists_app connection, unmeasured file-share duplication and unreachable buckets all limit confidence. Only {F003} of {F002} were measured. Each gap can be closed: a complete-pass census, rights bound to each candidate, a read grant, a fingerprinting pass and a bucket inventory reconciled with the provider.
Savings are estimates at list prices, not realised returns, and the candidates are not qualified datasets or permission for training. Nothing in this pack authorises execution.
